description: Score any text (20+ words) against the guest profile by feature-delta measurement. Returns voice_match_score (0-1), the per-feature `deltas` behind it, notes rendered from them and score_context caveats. On-voice text typically scores 0.85-0.95; below 0.45 is clearly off voice. Cite the delta numbers, do not invent detail. Free; 5 checks an hour per network (shared with compare_voice).

text.description: The text to score (20+ words, max ~50k chars).

name: check_voice_match
title: Score text against a voice
